{{Quote|Look, I really don't care who you are or why you're here. I just want my money.|Wlinc Tchrr|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
'''Wlinc Tchrr''' was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[bookmaker]] who worked for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He did not talk much about his business to strangers.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] he had a dispute with Imperial officer [[Gert Talnin]], who owed Tchrr money from a gambling debt. Talnin tried to pay the debt with Imperial travel vouchers, which Tchrr did not accept.

==Behind the scenes==
Wlinc Tchrr is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' and can be found in front of the [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] starport. He is not part of any quest or mission.
